import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if not isinstance(entity_ids, (list, np.ndarray, pd.Index)):
        entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    else:
        entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    feature_cols = [
        "num_orders", "num_items", "total_price", "total_freight",
        "mean_price", "max_price", "min_price", "std_price",
        "nunique_seller", "nunique_customer", "mean_freight",
        "mean_review", "review_count", "mean_payment_total",
        "mean_payment_installments", "mean_payment_count",
        "days_since_last", "product_age_days", "sales_per_month",
        "review_rate", "mean_delivery_delay", "has_sales",
        "sales_last_30d", "sales_last_90d", "sales_prev_90d",
        "trend_30d_vs_prev", "mean_days_to_approve", "mean_days_to_deliver",
        "frac_late_delivery", "mean_review_recent", "nunique_sellers_recent",
    ]

    # Only items of orders purchased strictly before seed_time
    mask_items = order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids) & (order_items["ts"] < seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask_items].copy()

    if items.empty:
        df = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"), columns=feature_cols)
        return df

    # Orders info: only fields that already exist at seed_time
    orders_sub = orders[[
        "order_id", "customer_id",
        "order_approved_at", "order_purchase_timestamp",
        "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date",
    ]]
    items = items.merge(orders_sub, how="left", on="order_id")

    # Approval date is known only if approved before seed_time
    items["approved_known"] = items["order_approved_at"].notna() & (items["order_approved_at"] < seed_time)
    items.loc[~items["approved_known"], "order_approved_at"] = pd.NaT

    # Delivery info known only if delivered before seed_time
    items["delivered_known"] = items["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() & (items["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    items.loc[~items["delivered_known"], "order_delivered_customer_date"] = pd.NaT

    # Payments: only payments recorded before seed_time
    pay_mask = payments["ts"] < seed_time
    pay_agg = payments.loc[pay_mask].groupby("order_id").agg(
        pay_count=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        pay_total=("payment_value", "sum"),
        pay_install_avg=("payment_installments", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    # Reviews: only reviews created before seed_time
    rev_mask = reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time
    rev_agg = reviews.loc[rev_mask].groupby("order_id").agg(
        rev_count=("review_score", "count"),
        rev_mean=("review_score", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()
    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    grouped = items.groupby("product_id")

    feature_agg = pd.DataFrame({
        "num_orders": grouped["order_id"].nunique(),
        "num_items": grouped["price"].count(),
        "total_price": grouped["price"].sum(),
        "total_freight": grouped["freight_value"].sum(),
        "mean_price": grouped["price"].mean(),
        "max_price": grouped["price"].max(),
        "min_price": grouped["price"].min(),
        "std_price": grouped["price"].std(),
        "nunique_seller": grouped["seller_id"].nunique(),
        "nunique_customer": grouped["customer_id"].nunique(),
        "mean_freight": grouped["freight_value"].mean(),
        "mean_review": grouped["rev_mean"].mean(),
        "review_count": grouped["rev_count"].sum(),
        "mean_payment_total": grouped["pay_total"].mean(),
        "mean_payment_installments": grouped["pay_install_avg"].mean(),
        "mean_payment_count": grouped["pay_count"].mean(),
        "first_ts": grouped["ts"].min(),
        "last_ts": grouped["ts"].max(),
    })

    # Time-based features
    feature_agg["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - feature_agg["last_ts"]).dt.days
    feature_agg["product_age_days"] = (seed_time - feature_agg["first_ts"]).dt.days
    age_positive = feature_agg["product_age_days"].clip(lower=1)
    feature_agg["sales_per_month"] = feature_agg["num_orders"] * 30 / age_positive
    feature_agg["review_rate"] = feature_agg["review_count"] / feature_agg["num_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # Recency-window sales counts
    ts = items["ts"]
    w30 = items.loc[ts >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)]
    w90 = items.loc[ts >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
    wprev90 = items.loc[(ts >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)) & (ts < seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90))]

    sales_30 = w30.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
    sales_90 = w90.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
    sales_prev90 = wprev90.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()

    feature_agg["sales_last_30d"] = feature_agg.index.map(sales_30).fillna(0)
    feature_agg["sales_last_90d"] = feature_agg.index.map(sales_90).fillna(0)
    feature_agg["sales_prev_90d"] = feature_agg.index.map(sales_prev90).fillna(0)
    feature_agg["trend_30d_vs_prev"] = feature_agg["sales_last_30d"] - feature_agg["sales_prev_90d"] / 3.0

    # Sellers active recently
    sellers_recent = w90.groupby("product_id")["seller_id"].nunique()
    feature_agg["nunique_sellers_recent"] = feature_agg.index.map(sellers_recent).fillna(0)

    # Delivery speed features (only for orders delivered before seed_time)
    delivered = items[items["delivered_known"]].copy()
    if not delivered.empty:
        delivered["days_to_deliver"] = (
            delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"] - delivered["order_purchase_timestamp"]
        ).dt.days
        delivered["is_late"] = (
            delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"] > delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        ).astype(float)
        dmean = delivered.groupby("product_id")["days_to_deliver"].mean()
        lrate = delivered.groupby("product_id")["is_late"].mean()
        feature_agg["mean_days_to_deliver"] = feature_agg.index.map(dmean)
        feature_agg["frac_late_delivery"] = feature_agg.index.map(lrate).fillna(0)
    else:
        feature_agg["mean_days_to_deliver"] = np.nan
        feature_agg["frac_late_delivery"] = 0.0

    # Approval speed (only known approvals)
    approved = items[items["approved_known"]].copy()
    if not approved.empty:
        approved["days_to_approve"] = (
            approved["order_approved_at"] - approved["order_purchase_timestamp"]
        ).dt.days
        amean = approved.groupby("product_id")["days_to_approve"].mean()
        feature_agg["mean_days_to_approve"] = feature_agg.index.map(amean)
    else:
        feature_agg["mean_days_to_approve"] = np.nan

    # Recent reviews (last 90 days before seed_time)
    rev_recent = reviews.loc[
        reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time
    ]
    rev_recent = rev_recent.merge(
        items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates("order_id"),
        on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    rev_recent = rev_recent.loc[
        rev_recent["review_creation_date"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    ]
    if not rev_recent.empty:
        rmean = rev_recent.groupby("product_id")["review_score"].mean()
        feature_agg["mean_review_recent"] = feature_agg.index.map(rmean)
    else:
        feature_agg["mean_review_recent"] = np.nan

    feature_agg["has_sales"] = 1

    feature_agg = feature_agg.drop(columns=["first_ts", "last_ts"], errors="ignore")
    feature_agg = feature_agg.fillna(0)

    feature_agg = feature_agg.reindex(pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"), fill_value=0)
    feature_agg = feature_agg[feature_cols]
    return feature_agg
